name: Card
description: The default container: a surface with an edge, plus optional media, header, body and footer parts.

props.name: surface
props.description: The surface. Emitted as data-surface. Glass falls back to raised under reduced transparency and in high contrast.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Adds the hover edge. Emitted as data-interactive. Set by href.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the title a link whose hit area covers the whole card. Buttons inside stay separately focusable.
props.a11y: One link per card: the title. Nested controls stay above the stretched hit area.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end of the header.

props.name: footer
props.description: The footer row, separated by an edge.

props.name: media
props.description: An image URL shown edge to edge above the header. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: mediaAlt
props.description: Alternative text for media. Empty marks it decorative.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { header: '…', body: '…' }.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The heading. It holds the link when href is set.

parts.name: actions
parts.description: Controls at the end of the header.

slots.name: media
slots.description: Overrides the media image, such as a video or a chart.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Rich title content, rendered inside the title heading.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Controls at the end of the header.

keyboard.action: Moves to the title link when href is set, then to each control inside.

requirements: A card is a plain container; give it a heading so it can be found.
With href, the title is the one link, and its hit area covers the card; nested buttons stay separately focusable and clickable.
The focus ring sits on the whole card while its title link has :focus-visible.
Glass falls back to --apui-surface-raised under prefers-reduced-transparency, without backdrop-filter, and in high contrast.
Text keeps 4.5:1 on every surface, glass included (--apui-text-muted-glass).
